entities.summary: Lucas Carlsson is a Swedish ice hockey defenceman who currently plays for the San Jose Barracuda in the American Hockey League (AHL) and is signed to the San Jose Sharks of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was drafted by the Chicago Blackhawks in the fourth round, 110th overall, of the 2016 NHL Entry Draft.
